title: Purair® BASIC Ductless Fume Cupboards
meta_title: Purair Basic Ductless Fume Hoods - Compact Lab Safety Solutions
meta_description: The Purair Basic Series ductless fume cupboards provide compact, space-saving solutions for handling small volumes of hazardous substances in the lab.
meta_keywords: ductless fume hood, ductless fume cupboard, lab safety equipment, compact fume hood, cyanoacrylate fuming chamber
short_description: The Purair® Basic Series ductless fume cupboards are compact, ideal for use in laboratory environments where space is limited or where only small volumes of harmful substances are handled. For package and mail inspection workstations, see Purair SafeSEARCH.
full_description: Using innovative filtration technology, the Purair Basic creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry. Compounding \ Balance Enclosures, Microscopes, and Robotic Equipment \ Forensics \ Histology \ Educational \ Microscopy \ Mobile and Classroom Demonstrations \ Pharmaceutical \ Powder Fingerprinting \ Powder Weighing \ Sample Prep Work \ Soldering \ Solvent Cleaning and Welding \ Veterinary \ Dental
seo_content: The Purair Basic Series ductless fume cupboards feature high efficiency EC blowers, energy-saving LED lighting, and filter blockage alarms to protect operators from fume and particle hazards. A unique filter clamping design eliminates bypass leakage outside the cabinet.

Construction & Compliance.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. This product may assist you with compliance or as part of your chemical hygiene plan. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
